verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI explicitly advertises debugging/troubleshooting via natural language and on-demand @gemini-cli assistance for issues/PRs, and some users praise its large-context codebase navigation. However, multiple hands-on reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing basic function calls, being 'terrible at agentic stuff,' and even causing catastrophic data loss during a troubleshooting session, directly contradicting the polished vendor claim.
